_comment: 10e Detachment Enhancements (Warlord upgrades). One Enhancement may be taken per CHARACTER and each unique Enhancement once per army (Wahapedia core rules, 'Enhancements' section). This starter set covers ONE Enhancement per Detachment we already wire end-to-end (Gladius, Awakened Dynasty, Cult of Magic, Plague Company, Mont'ka). Mechanical mappings are simplifications where the canonical effect is bespoke (one-shot teleport, modified Critical Hit threshold, contagion-aura-range tweak) — each entry's `effect` field documents the divergence per CLAUDE.md §10.

Enhancement.Champion of Humanity.quoted_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
Enhancement.Champion of Humanity.trigger: the bearer's unit is selected to make attacks against a CHARACTER target
Enhancement.Champion of Humanity.effect: +1 to wound on attacks (simplification: SwegHammer applies the +1 wound aura-wide on the bearer's unit rather than gating to CHARACTER targets only, because the focus-fire heuristic in army.pick_target preferentially picks the lowest-health enemy unit which is often but not always a CHARACTER; the to-hit half of the rule is folded into the same effect bucket to keep the per-enhancement modifier surface small)

Enhancement.Hyperphasic Fulcrum.quoted_text: CRYPTEK model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, if that unit is wholly within your army's Power Matrix, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
Enhancement.Hyperphasic Fulcrum.trigger: the bearer's unit is selected to make Wound rolls
Enhancement.Hyperphasic Fulcrum.effect: re-roll Wound rolls of 1 on the bearer's unit (LC-4 correction: previous mapping was +1 to hit, which was a misread of an earlier draft; BSData v10.6.0 verbatim is reroll-wound-1s. SwegHammer drops the CRYPTEK-only host gate at the runtime layer because the warlord picker chooses the highest-points CHARACTER which is rarely a CRYPTEK, and drops the Power Matrix wholly-within gate because SwegHammer has no Power Matrix deployment token; both APPROXIMATIONS widen the host pool but the buff itself is faithful.)

Enhancement.Phasal Subjugator.quoted_text: NECRONS model only. While a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding CHARACTER units) is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the hit roll.
Enhancement.Phasal Subjugator.trigger: the bearer's unit (or a friendly NECRONS unit in 6") makes a Hit roll
Enhancement.Phasal Subjugator.effect: +1 to the Hit roll on the bearer's unit. SwegHammer applies the aura through the existing leader-proximity merge in effective_buffs — the 6" range is enforced by the host CHARACTER's LeaderAbility.aura_range. The CHARACTER-excluding clause is a no-op here because Enhancement auras don't fire on the CHARACTER bearer's own attacks (the bearer is treated as part of its led unit for buff purposes; SwegHammer's CHARACTER models share buffs with their bodyguards).

Enhancement.Veiled Blade.quoted_text: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any Command phase, triple the bearer's Objective Control characteristic until the end of the turn.
Enhancement.Veiled Blade.trigger: the bearer's unit is selected to make melee Attacks
Enhancement.Veiled Blade.effect: +2 melee Attacks on the bearer's weapons (SwegHammer's aura schema doesn't distinguish bearer-only buffs from bodyguard-unit buffs, so the +2 attacks is applied unit-wide on the bearer's squad — slight over-coverage compared to the bearer-only codex wording, but the bearer in Custodian Wardens / Guard squads is typically the single source of melee output anyway). The once-per-battle OC triple is DROPPED — SwegHammer's objective scoring model doesn't gate buffs through the OC stat in a way that benefits from a single-character one-shot triple.

Enhancement.Puretide Engram Neurochip.quoted_text: Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, you can target one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to the bearer (or within Engagement Range of it in the Fight phase). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack against that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Enhancement.Puretide Engram Neurochip.trigger: the bearer's unit is selected to make Hit rolls
Enhancement.Puretide Engram Neurochip.effect: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 on the bearer's unit (simplification: SwegHammer collapses the once-per-battle 'target one unit, re-roll all Hits' into a permanent re-roll-Hits-of-1 aura on the bearer's unit; across a 5-round game with selective targeting the expected hit-yield gain is roughly equivalent)
